laws.rule: Kanazawa City accommodation tax: JPY 200 a person a night for room rates under JPY 20,000 (about A$1.80), JPY 500 from JPY 20,000 (about A$4.51) (RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82). No tax under JPY 5,000 (about A$45.12).
laws.heading: 金沢市宿泊税条例 (arts 3-2, 4)

laws.rule: Ishikawa Children Comprehensive Ordinance (いしかわ子ども総合条例), art. 55. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 4 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 300,000 (about A$2,707). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
laws.heading: いしかわ子ども総合条例 (Ishikawa), curfew for young people

laws.rule: Kanazawa City: 金沢市におけるぽい捨て等のない快適で美しいまちづくりの推進に関する条例 (Kanazawa Ordinance on a Comfortable, Beautiful City Free of Littering etc.), art. 18: in the mayor's designated priority zones (重点区域) smoking in roads and other public places is banned. Elsewhere in public places art. 14 asks people to make an effort not to smoke in a way that harms others. The mayor can guide, warn and order a stop (art. 19); breaking an order is punishable by an administrative fine (過料) of up to JPY 10,000 (about A$90, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82). The zone map was not read.

Kanazawa City, whole city: littering is banned (art. 12 of the same ordinance) and a dog's droppings may not be left (art. 13). In priority zones the mayor can order a clean-up, and the fine of up to JPY 10,000 applies to ignoring an order.

Higashi Chaya district, Kanazawa: the Kanazawa Tourism Association says eating while walking is banned in the part designated as a preservation district; eat inside the grounds of the shop where you bought the food. It also says the teahouses (ochaya) take guests by introduction only. This is from the association's visitor guide; no ordinance for it was found.
